project_name: StreamPulse - Real-Time Telemetry & Event Stream Processing Pipeline
theme: Dark Operations Console (Tactical Monolithic Operator Interface)
emotional_archetype: Tactical Precision & Command Center Focus (Performance Pro + Swiss High-Contrast)
design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine high-density Datadog/Grafana signal grids with Bloomberg Terminal typography, clean radar-style live motion indicators, and military-grade incident hierarchy.

Incident-First Ergonomics: Operational actions (Acknowledge, Resolve, Pause Stream, Resume Stream) are elevated with instant keybindings (e.g. Shift+P for pause, Esc to clear modal) and distinct non-ambiguous visual states.
Dense Data Scanning: Zero waste padding, sharp borders (1px tinted border), clear status badges with glow rings, clear tabular density with fixed key-value alignments.

Tactical Color System: Deep Void Obsidian `#090C10` and Carbon `#0D1117` background layers with Emerald `#10B981` (healthy), Electric Crimson `#EF4444` (critical alert), Amber Gold `#F59E0B` (warning/lagging), Cyan `#06B6D4` (processing/active), and Slate/Muted `#64748B` (paused/idle).
Living Feed Motion: Live telemetry ticks receive subtle micro-pulses (`animate-pulse-subtle`) and status changes use high-contrast outline flashes rather than distracting motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React + Tailwind CSS with Lucide icons and Recharts for dense telemetry visualization.
Implement full mock state and real-time interval updates (1-2 second ticks) for event throughput, latency, consumer lag, and live tail logs.

Support active user interaction for stream control: clicking 'Pause Stream' updates global status, shows a amber pause warning bar across top console, and stops auto-generating log feed until 'Resume Stream' is clicked.

Ensure incident acknowledgment immediately changes badge state to 'ACKNOWLEDGED' with timestamp and operator name, and resolving an alert opens a dialog for resolution notes before removing it or placing it in 'RESOLVED' history.
Provide clear configuration management where connection parameters (Kafka bootstrap servers, Redis host, Timescale DB string) can be configured, tested, and saved.
Maintain strict data-testid attributes on all interactive controls for automated testing validation.
Use strict dark mode with dark borders (#21262D), glass opacity dropdowns/modals (bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md), monospace numeric data formatting, and zero unstyled native UI elements.
